summary: This informational document gives example call flows showing how Session Initiation Protocol uses TLS and S/MIME. It helps implementers build interoperable software and includes certificates used in the examples so tests can be repeated. The examples show messages step by step.

eli5.summary: This is a worked example book for secure phone calls over the internet, showing every message in order. Programmers can copy the steps to check their own work.

questions: how to test sip security interoperability
